name: Sida
summary: In Menethil Harbor, Sida lives apart from her estranged husband, Einar Stonegrip. She spends her days in the Wetlands port and sometimes ventures into the marshes, where she recently lost her bag near Ironbeard's Tomb.

sections.title: A Harbor Resident
sections.body: Sida lives in Menethil Harbor, the Alliance port in the Wetlands, apart from Einar Stonegrip. Their marriage is strained, and Einar refuses to travel to Menethil while Sida remains there. She still sometimes ventures beyond the coastal settlement into the Wetlands. On a recent trip toward Ironbeard's Tomb, she lost her personal bag.

faq.answer: Sida is a dwarven woman living in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. She gives tasks to adventurers passing through the port.
Sida lost her bag while visiting Ironbeard's Tomb, an ancient burial site in the Wetlands. Foul oozes have overrun the area and swallowed her belongings.

faq.q: Why won't Einar Stonegrip visit Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Einar Stonegrip is Sida's estranged husband. Bad blood between them keeps him away from Menethil Harbor while Sida lives there.
You can find Sida along the docks and roads of Menethil Harbor, on the Wetlands' western coast.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see everyday town life in Menethil Harbor alongside domestic disputes and the dangers of the wilderness beyond its gates.
As an Alliance traveler arriving at Menethil Harbor's docks, you can take local errands from Sida that lead inland toward Ironbeard's Tomb.
